title: Missing fetus syndrome: grays take back hybrid fetuses

tellings.quote: The grays come and get the fetus.

plain: Women carrying part-alien hybrid pregnancies are said to lose them because the grays, the small grey beings of abduction reports, come back for the fetus. Tim Alberino, a filmmaker and researcher, tells Michels this without naming a source, saying simply: "The grays come and get the fetus." It is offered as the explanation for what some call missing fetus syndrome, where a pregnancy vanishes without a trace.
